title: Movie & TV cards
notes: A new free TMDB extension is in the Marketplace. Pick your movie/TV boards, then title a topic with a film or show name — Convoro pulls the poster, overview, cast, where-to-watch and a trailer from The Movie Database and renders it as a rich card on the first post. You get a live match preview as you type, and a movie thread needs only a title.

changelog.text: The free TMDB extension is now in the Marketplace — title a topic with a film/show name in a movie board and Convoro renders a rich card (poster, overview, cast, where-to-watch, trailer) from The Movie Database on the first post.
Live match preview as you type the title, and movie threads need only a title — the card is the post.
